testcase.name: select cc file then read binary returns capability container plus 9000()
unknown instruction returns fallback status word without crashing()
read binary without prior select returns file-not-found()
select unknown file id returns file-not-found()
read binary exactly at end of file returns empty data with success()
select with unsupported p1 p2 returns wrong-parameters()
null apdu is rejected with wrong-length rather than crashing()
read binary offset beyond file length returns wrong-parameters()
read binary chunking across multiple calls with small le reconstructs the full ndef file()
read binary with short-ef-identifier bit set is rejected()
updating the ndef message resets file selection so a fresh select is required()
updated ndef message is reflected in subsequent reads()
le of zero is treated as 256 per iso7816-4 and does not crash()
unsupported class byte returns fallback status word()
select apdu whose declared lc exceeds actual remaining bytes is rejected()
truncated apdu shorter than 4 bytes is rejected with wrong-length()
